title: Greppy web-runtime artifact manifest v1
description: Manifest for content-addressed web-runtime artifacts. Large immutable objects live at objects/sha256/<digest> under the run-scoped root <agent-data>/web-runtime/<run-id>/. Runtime state MUST live under the current Greppy agent data/scratch root, not inside source directories. Raw artifacts containing credentials require explicit operator access and MUST be marked sensitive.

media_type.description: IANA media type of the stored object.

producing_operation.description: Operation that produced the artifact (protocol request_id or public operation name plus request_id).

redaction_status.description: Logs, traces, screenshots, request headers, and page content MUST pass a redaction layer before becoming model-visible.

sensitive.description: True when the object may contain credentials or other sensitive material.

credential_labeled.description: True when the artifact is labeled as containing credentials not representable by Playwright storage-state semantics, or any injected credential material.

object_path.description: Content-addressed object path convention objects/sha256/<digest> relative to the run root.

run_root.description: Absolute or agent-data-relative directory for this run. MUST be under the Greppy agent data/scratch root.

session_subdir.description: sessions/<session-id>/ relative to the run root when the artifact is session-scoped.

evidence.description: Evidence fields used by web research. Page content is untrusted and MUST be wrapped in an explicit untrusted-content boundary in model-facing output.

continuation_token.description: Present when more evidence exists beyond this compact answer pack.

omitted_count.description: Count of sources or snippets omitted from model-facing output.

truncated_count.description: Count of payloads truncated to satisfy output or artifact budgets.
